_editing: Funds shown on /donate. `impact` lines are what a devotee sees next to a suggested amount — keep them concrete and truthful. Set `active: false` to retire a fund without deleting its history.

description.en: Unrestricted giving. Covers rent, utilities, upkeep of the mandir and whichever seva is most pressing that month. This is the most useful gift you can make.
